CHIEF DESIGN OFFICER

A point of view.
In every format.

The Red Studio brings identity, digital products, campaigns, motion and sound into one conversation. We start with your audience and what you need to communicate, then choose the right format.

“Death to AI slop” is our stance on generic, unconsidered work. Tools can help; judgement, authorship and responsibility for what we deliver stay with us.

You see who’s making the work, why we chose a direction, and what you’ll receive. We design for people: readable type, useful interfaces, accessible controls and motion they can pause.

ILLUSTRATIVE WORKFLOW / NOT A CLIENT PROJECT

Three things
we stand for.

No AI slop.

An idea needs a reason to exist. We discuss sources and any proposed AI assistance, and review the final work for originality, relevance, accuracy and rights.

Data ethics by design.

Use sample data where possible. Agree access, suppliers and retention before handling project data. Read our approach ↗

Transparent by default.

Published package prices, defined scopes and visible decisions. Extra work gets your approval first. See our prices ↗
